name: M3 Personnel Armor
notes: USCMC vest, abdomen pad and greaves with a built-in comm unit, PDT, webbing and vitals telemetry.

name: IRC Mk.50 Compression Suit
notes: Decades-old but trusted vacuum suit with HUD, head lamp and wireless helmet cam. The table lists AGILITY -1 for this suit (see fidelity notes).

name: IRC Mk.35 Pressure Suit
notes: Cheap, bulky USCMC combat pressure suit; joints stiffen under strain and it needs decompression time after EVA. Heavy item.

name: Eco All-World Systems Survival Suit
notes: Articulated EVA hardsuit with HUD and maneuvering thrusters; its comm array is unshielded. Heavy item.

name: Weyland-Yutani APEsuit
notes: Armored all-purpose environment suit with filtered air; resists temperature extremes and caustics but is not vacuum-rated.

name: Caterpillar P-5000 Powered Work Loader
notes: Cargo exoskeleton with hydraulic claws and roll cage. Requires HEAVY MACHINERY 2+ to operate. Close combat attacks with it deal base Damage 3. Cannot be carried.

name: M10 Ballistic Helmet
notes: Part of the M3 armor set: tactical camera feed, passive IR sight and an IFF transmitter that keeps sentry guns off you. No separate rating or price.

name: Kevlar Riot Vest
notes: Light woven vest worn by colonial police and security.

name: Armat CM4 Plastisteel Riot Shield
notes: Takes a slow action to set; then counts as cover with Armor Rating 5 on top of body armor. Moving loses the cover.

name: 6B90 Combat Armor
notes: Heavy UPP infantry armor with comm unit and tactical camera.

name: CCC5 Combat Compression Suit
notes: UPP armored vacuum suit with a narrow visor; comes with an AK-104s suit gun.

name: Military Grade HAZMAT Suit
notes: Full chemical/biological protection while unbreached. Against each Radiation Point roll six Base Dice; any success means the suit absorbs it. Not vacuum-rated. Listed under protective gear.

name: MOX Mark 1 Mobile Offensive Exowarrior Suit
notes: Project Berserker cyber-exosuit with integrated 25mm gatling, M240 incinerator, stun baton, U1 launcher, U4 launcher with QTC rounds and a Damage 2 claw. Does not encumber; immune to acid. Wearer cannot use EMPATHY-based skills. Not for sale.
